A letter, just for you

Basagin mo ang tatak kapag handa ka na. (Break the seal when you’re ready.)

My Gwen,

months have drifted by like leaves since you walked away from the family that once held you—not out of weakness, but for the sake of our love and to save the quiet flame of yourself from their shadows. Day by day you carry that ache, and I have watched you meet it with a courage that leaves me breathless; as your partner, as your future husband, I am proud of you in ways my heart can barely speak—proud that even in your lowest hour, when the world feels heavy and cold, you still find the strength to open your soul and let your troubles breathe in the light.

My Gwen, I love you beyond the reach of simple words, and I am sorry for every pressure I placed upon your shoulders—for every moment my wish to make you stronger felt like a weight instead of a hand to hold. You were already braver than I knew, already blooming through storms I could not see; so I will love you gently, stand beside you faithfully, and dream with you of the family we will build—a home where you are safe, cherished, and never, never alone. Always, my love—always.
